demos.name: Privilege model fallback LAB
demos.description: An LLM key names an ordered chain of models: the second answers when the first is down, overloaded or out of budget, charged on its own budget. Nine scenarios, a named refusal when nothing can answer. Mock only; beyond the release-notes sentence everything is the lab's own model and UNVERIFIED.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7836, PROVISIONAL and not claimed on the board). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials; Real is not built (the toggle is disabled with the reason). Docker: HOST_PORT=7836 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). catalogId D000 is a placeholder: the owner assigns the real catalog id and the port before the registry entry is made. Repo: curtismu7/privilege-model-fallback-LAB.
